questions.question: During a vehicle inspection test, you must be able to do all of the following about oil, except:

options.text: Point out where the dipstick is.
Show that the oil level is safe.
Show that the oil level is above the refill mark.
Show that the oil level is below the refill mark.

questions.correctAnswerText: Show that the oil level is below the refill mark.
questions.explanation: During a vehicle inspection test, you must point out where the dipstick is, show that the oil level is safe, and show that the oil level is above the refill mark.

questions.question: If you need to back up at a student pick-up point, you should:

options.text: Back up before students board the bus.
Wait until all students have boarded before backing up.
Let half the students board, then back up to meet the rest.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until all students have boarded before backing up.
questions.explanation: Never back up a school bus until all students have boarded. Always watch for students who may board late.

questions.question: Before evacuating a bus due to a hazard, a driver should:

options.text: Ask students if they want to leave.
Contact the dispatcher and explain the situation.
Take time to decide if an evacuation is needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Contact the dispatcher and explain the situation.
questions.explanation: If time allows, contact your dispatcher to explain the situation before evacuating a school bus. Make the decision to evacuate quickly when needed.

questions.question: If a driver needs to exit a school bus to check that all students have boarded, the driver should:

options.text: Leave the engine running.
Turn off the engine and take the key.
Ask another driver to watch the bus.
Ask all students to exit the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the engine and take the key.
questions.explanation: If you cannot find a student while boarding, turn off the bus, take the key with you, and check around and underneath the bus.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing in a school bus, you should:

options.text: Stop 15 to 50 feet before the nearest rail.
Stop 100 feet before the nearest rail.
Stop 10 feet before the nearest rail.
Cross the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop 15 to 50 feet before the nearest rail.
questions.explanation: Stop at railroad crossings to look for trains. Stop no closer than 15 feet and no farther than 50 feet from the rails to see best. Look and listen for approaching trains before crossing.

questions.question: The overhead inside rearview mirror should show:

options.text: The rear tires.
All students on the bus.
The floor of the bus.
The ceiling of the bus.

questions.explanation: The overhead mirror helps you watch students inside the bus. Position it to show the top of the rear window. This lets you see all students, including those sitting directly behind you.

questions.question: Pre-trip inspections should be done:

options.text: Differently each time to check different items.
The same way each time so you don't forget anything.
Once in a while.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same way each time so you don't forget anything.
questions.explanation: Do pre-trip inspections the same way before every drive. This helps you learn all steps and makes sure you don't miss anything.

questions.question: When boarding a school bus, students should:

options.text: Walk in a single-file line.
Walk in pairs.
Not use the handrail.

questions.explanation: Students should board slowly in a single-file line. They should use the handrail for safety.

questions.question: If a bus must be evacuated, students should be led:

options.text: No more than 50 feet away from the bus.
Downwind of the bus in case of fire.
Far away from any railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Far away from any railroad tracks.
questions.explanation: After evacuation, lead students to a safe place at least 100 feet from the road in the direction of oncoming traffic. Keep them upwind of any fire and as far as possible from railroad tracks.

questions.question: A blind spot behind a school bus extends at least ____ feet.
questions.explanation: A school bus has blind spots below and in front of the mirrors and behind the rear bumper. Rear blind spots usually extend 50 to 150 feet behind a bus, but can sometimes reach 400 feet depending on the bus length.

questions.question: A post-trip inspection should include all of the following, except:

options.text: Check for items left on the bus.
Check for sleeping students.
Open windows.

questions.explanation: After a trip ends, inspect the bus for sleeping students, belongings left behind, open windows or doors, mechanical problems, and damage.

questions.question: Loading a school bus:

options.text: Is not dangerous.
Does not need supervision.
Should be done quickly.
Can be dangerous.

questions.explanation: More students die during loading and unloading than while riding the bus. School bus drivers must follow safety procedures during these times.

questions.question: If you must back up at a student pick-up point, you should:

options.text: Back up before students board the bus.
Back up after students board the bus.
Back up while students direct you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Back up after students board the bus.
questions.explanation: Backing up is not safe and should only be done if there is no other way to move the bus. If you must back up at a pick-up point, wait until all students have boarded first.

questions.question: If you must drive a school bus during high winds, you should:

options.text: Loosen your grip on the steering wheel.
Increase your speed.
Reduce your speed.
Drive normally.

questions.explanation: Slow down when driving in high winds. Hold the steering wheel firmly and watch for wind gusts.

questions.question: ABS helps you:

options.text: Lock up the wheels.
Keep the wheels from locking up.
Count the number of students boarding the bus.
Predict the weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep the wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) stops the wheels from locking up when you brake hard.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you will be required to do all of the following, except:

options.text: Walk around the vehicle.
Point to or touch each item.
Explain what you are checking and why.
Crawl under the vehicle.

questions.explanation: For your CDL test, you must walk around the vehicle, point to or touch items, and explain what you are checking and why. You do not need to crawl under the vehicle or hood.

questions.question: During the pre-trip inspection test, you will be:

options.text: Expected to explain your knowledge of the pre-trip process.
Watching someone else check your vehicle.
Watching a film on how to inspect a vehicle.
Changing all the tires on your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expected to explain your knowledge of the pre-trip process.
questions.explanation: During the inspection test, you will do a complete inspection of your vehicle and explain what you are checking and why.

questions.question: The overhead rearview mirror is located:

options.text: On the outside left of the bus.
On the outside right of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: In a school bus, the overhead rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side.

questions.question: If equipped with flashing lights, how far before a stop should the bus's lights be turned on?

options.text: At least 50 feet
At least 100 feet
At least 200 feet
At least 1,000 feet

questions.explanation: If a school bus has flashing amber warning lights, turn them on at least 200 feet before you stop, unless state law says otherwise.

questions.question: If a railroad crossing gate does not go up after a train passes, you should:

options.text: Drive around the gate.
Wait for another vehicle to cross first to see if it is safe.
Call your dispatcher.

questions.explanation: If a gate stays down after a train passes, call your dispatcher. Do not drive around the lowered gate.
